# E0366: a lens writes a literal its target rejects

A literal the lens writes is not an instance of the target at that path. Here
the target wants a list of one int and the lens writes two elements.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				l: [int]
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			l: [v0_0.a, 1]
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.l[0]
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0366]: l in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is a list of 2 elements, which the target schema does not accept: incompatible list lengths (1 and 2)
  --> lineage.cue:22:4
   |
22 |             l: [v0_0.a, 1]
   |             ^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule literal-not-instance)
```
